name: Judder Fist
description: Throw a fist that judders on impact so the shake runs deep into the muscle it strikes.

name: Muted Guard
description: Hold a layer of damped air before the body that deadens a heavy blow to a dull knock.

name: Dip Tempo
description: Drop under the beat of the foe's swing and rise again behind it.

name: Echo Mark
description: Mark a foe with a faint ping and follow the echo of it wherever they move.

name: Rolling Jolt
description: Send a rolling jolt through the foe's guard that carries on into the chest and breaks their rhythm.

name: Dampened Frame
description: Hold the whole frame in a damping hum so that shock is soaked up by the air before it reaches the bone.

name: Rhythm Lift
description: Beat a lifting cadence on the chest to quicken the user's strikes and keep them landing on the same count.

name: Quaking Palm
description: Drive an open palm into the foe with a deep quake behind it that jars the organs and drops the guard.

name: Concussive Ring
description: Stamp and loose a ring of concussive sound that hammers every foe in reach and sends them reeling.

name: Hairline Tap
description: Tap the foe's weapon at a seam of the metal and set a hairline crack running along it.

name: Resounding Cover
description: Throw up a cover of resounding air that sends the force of a cut back along the blade.

name: Lilting Step
description: Glide through the guard on a lilting step that rises and falls with the foe's breathing.

name: Fault Hearing
description: Hear the faults in the foe's armor and blade by the way they ring when the foe moves.

name: Reed Tone
description: Breathe one long reed-thin tone that steadies the aim and the stance for the stroke to come.

name: Splitting Note
description: Loose a thin note that finds the joint of the foe's armor and widens it into a gap.

name: Stunning Clap
description: Clap once before the foe's face with a sharp crack that stuns the ears and the balance together.

name: Ringing Guard
description: Meet a cut with a ringing parry whose shake runs up the foe's weapon arm and numbs it.

name: Sundering Chord
description: Strike a chord whose notes match the grain of the foe's guard so that it opens along its own seams.

name: Unmaking Pitch
description: Raise a pitch to the foe's breaking point and loose it at once so the weapon shatters and the hand behind it goes numb.

name: Hum Tone
description: Hum the qi field into a wide even tone that the user can lean on in every motion.

name: Reaching Pulse
description: Throw a short pulse of sound a few paces from the fingertips to slap a foe beyond arm's reach.

name: Broad Hush
description: Spread a veil of tone through the field that thins out incoming force at a distance.

name: Long Listen
description: Hear out to the edge of the field and mark each living thing that moves inside it.

name: Fanning Wave
description: Spread a heavy wave of sound outward through the field to push back every foe near the user.

name: Fieldwide Hearing
description: Let the whole field listen at once so that no step or breath inside it passes unheard.

name: Distant Peal
description: Cast a heavy peal across the field to strike a distant foe with the full weight of a thrown boulder.

name: Cloaking Resonance
description: Wrap the field round the body as a ringing cloak that shakes apart missiles and blades before they touch.

name: Paired Rap
description: Rap twice on the same spot with the knuckle so the second knock lands as the first still rings.

name: Twin Hum
description: Hum two notes a fifth apart so that their beating forms a shield against light blows.

name: Twofold Step
description: Take two steps on a single beat so that the foe reads only one.

name: Duet Listen
description: Send one note out and let a second return so that the gap between them gives the distance of the foe.

name: Paired Breath
description: Breathe in two lengths together so that body and qi swell and settle in unison.

name: Twin Peal
description: Ring two peals from either hand that meet at the foe's guard and drive it apart.

name: Answering Note
description: Answer a strike with a note that turns it aside and sends back the same note as a counter.

name: Dual Pitch
description: Sound two clashing pitches at once so that the foe's balance and hearing both give way.

name: Duet Shatter
description: Loose a high note and a low note that meet in the foe's body and burst a hard guard from within.

name: Counterpoint Guard
description: Weave two opposed lines of tone round the body that cancel the force of strikes from both sides.

name: Hawk Whistle
description: Whistle a short hawk call that startles the foe into a flinch.

name: Falling Cry
description: Drop onto the foe from above with a fist and a falling cry.

name: Keen Ear
description: Sharpen the ear to the pitch of a hawk and catch the smallest rustle of a hidden foe.

name: Feathered Hush
description: Cloak the body in a feathered hush that turns aside weak thrusts with no sound.

name: Diving Shriek
description: Shriek on a falling pitch so the point of sound bores down into the foe's raised guard.

name: Keen Reach
description: Stretch a hawk's hearing across the field and pick out one voice among a crowd of sounds.

name: Piercing Dive
description: Dive at the foe on a shrill cry and come out of the strike a pace away.

name: Raptor Shriek
description: Loose a raptor's shriek honed to a needle that pierces armor and shield alike.

name: Sky Warning
description: Cry out a warning note that tells the user and allies near them where danger comes from and quickens their reactions.

name: Handbell Strike
description: Swing a fist like a handbell clapper and let the ring ride into the foe's body.

name: Muffled Bell
description: Hold a muffled bell of air round the body to take a hard knock without a sound.

name: Toll Step
description: Step on the toll of an inner bell and cross the gap before the ring dies.

name: Bell Hearing
description: Ring a small bell of qi and hear in the way it fades what lies beyond a door or wall.

name: Clapper Tune
description: Tune the body like a bell so that every motion rings true and clean.

name: Silver Note
description: Ring a bright silver note over an ally or the self that closes shallow cuts and calms bruised flesh.

name: Great Toll
description: Toll a huge bell in the chest and loose the boom in a single palm strike.

name: Cracked Bell
description: Sound a cracked flat note that rattles the foe's concentration and spoils their technique.

name: Cleansing Peal
description: Ring a clean peal over an ally or the self that shakes poison and taint out of the blood.

name: Waking Toll
description: Toll a deep slow bell over an ally whose breath has just stopped and shake the heart into beating again before the short window closes.

name: Azure Knell
description: Strike a knell whose toll rolls out in all directions and staggers every foe within the field.

name: Oath Hum
description: Hum a sworn pledge to the wind until the user's resolve and breath move as one.

name: Sworn Rap
description: Rap the foe's guard with a pledge-hard knuckle that carries the oath's weight.

name: Windlike Hush
description: Draw a hush as soft as moving air about the body to blunt a strike.

name: Bearing Note
description: Sound a clear note and take a bearing on the returning echo that holds true.

name: Pledged Peal
description: Ring a peal pledged to one target that cannot be turned from it once it is loosed.

name: Held Note
description: Hold a single note without breaking it until it becomes a steady guard round the body.

name: Sounded Bearing
description: Take a bearing on a foe by sound and keep it however the foe turns or hides.

name: Oathbound Toll
description: Toll a pledge on the foe that lands as a blow and leaves them slowed by its weight.

name: Steadfast Hum
description: Hum a steadfast tone round the body that holds fast against blows from every side.

name: Returning Knock
description: Knock the foe and let the echo return a second knock a heartbeat later.

name: Echo Shield
description: Cast the sound of a blow back at the air before it so the force dies in its own echo.

name: Echo Stride
description: Leave an echo of the body where it stood and stride on while the foe strikes at the echo.

name: Far Hearing
description: Hear the echoes of the open ground far out and judge the number and gait of those who cross it.

name: Resounding Breath
description: Breathe in time with a slow echo until the user's strength returns at each beat.

name: Echo Volley
description: Hurl a call that bounces back and forth across the field and strikes the foe three times.

name: Echo Return
description: Catch the noise of an incoming strike and return it to the striker at half strength.

name: Rebounding Cry
description: Cry out so that the cry rebounds from the foe's own guard and shakes their stance.

name: Double Echo
description: Strike once and let two echoes follow so that three blows fall where the foe saw one.

name: Echo Reversal
description: Fold the full echo of a field-wide strike back along its path to land on the one who sent it.

name: Stilled Palm
description: Strike with a palm that carries no sound and leaves the target numb where it lands.

name: Lifeless Air
description: Still the air about the body so that vibrations die before they reach the skin.

name: Quiet Footfall
description: Cross the ground without one sound in the space of a breath.

name: Hushed Listen
description: Make the user's own body silent so that every other sound stands clear.

name: Hushed Breath
description: Hold the breath in the silence and let the stillness gather strength in the limbs.

name: Hush Mend
description: Wrap an ally or the self in a deep hush that lets torn flesh knit without the shock of motion.

name: Smothering Hush
description: Smother one foe in a hush so complete that their voice and their calling of techniques fail.

name: Vacuum Clap
description: Clap the hands to pull the sound from a patch of air and leave a sudden dead pressure on the foe.

name: Deadening Pulse
description: Send a deadening pulse that dulls the foe's senses and the feel of their weapon in their hand.

name: Soundless Strike
description: Strike without any sound or sign of qi so that the foe cannot hear the blow until it lands.

name: Voiceless Weight
description: Spread the silence across the field so that every foe within it is dulled and struck by a weight of dead air.

name: Stillness Cure
description: Hold an ally in a deep stillness that stops a spreading poison or a Qi Deviation backlash and draws it out.
